items.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
items.snippet: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

items.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
items.snippet: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

items.title: Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
items.snippet: The central bank is surveying 31 financial institutions on how a major exchange shutdown, prolonged crypto downturn or losses at another firm could affect their operations.

items.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
items.snippet: THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.
